title: Leiyan Valley
summary: Ling Qingzhu and Yuan Cang track down an intruder from the Western Xuan Region, who blows himself up rather than answer. In Yang City, Mu Hongling tells Lin Dong and Mo Ling about an ancient treasure in Leiyan Valley that includes a Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, which can lift a Spirit Symbol Master to Heaven Symbol Master. They go together, though Little Mink warns that she is hiding something. In the valley the Demon Rock Dynasty's Chen Mu drives off Hua Yun of the Xuanbing Dynasty. Lin Dong pushes past Hua Yun's men with the Nirvana Golden Body and five fingers, and Hua Yun lets him in, planning to strike later for the Ancient Secret Key. Inside, Lin Dong and Little Flame search the lower level for the tree, and the ground starts to shake.
events: A Western Xuan Region intruder attacks Yuan Cang and Ling Qingzhu and blows himself up.
Lin Dong returns to Yang City, where Mo Ling asks to be called by name.
Mu Hongling invites them to Leiyan Valley for the treasure and the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree.
At the valley Chen Mu of the Demon Rock Dynasty forces Hua Yun of the Xuanbing Dynasty to withdraw.
Lin Dong fights Hua Yun with the Nirvana Golden Body and five fingers, and Hua Yun lets him through.
Hua Yun reveals the Xuanbing Dynasty's goal is the Ancient Secret Key.
Lin Dong and Little Flame go to the lower level while Mo Ling and Mu Hongling search above; an earthquake strikes.
cultivation: Lin Dong is at Manifestation peak. Chen Mu and Hua Yun are both Nirvana experts.
